scenes.basis: 2:4 "into Judea, to David's city, which is called Bethlehem"; 2:7 "She gave birth to her firstborn son"
2:8 "There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field"; 2:15 "Let's go to Bethlehem"
2:21 "When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child" - at the Bethlehem house of 2:6-7, which the verse does not name
2:22 "they brought him up to Jerusalem"; 2:27 "He came in the Spirit into the temple"
2:39 "they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth"
2:42 "they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast"; 2:46 "they found him in the temple"
2:51 "He went down with them, and came to Nazareth"
